description: Use this when the person wants a day pass or a meeting room. Pass up to 3 venue slugs from search_venues (or only a city — and near, when they want to be close to a place — for the nearest spaces that book directly), the date and how many people. Returns, per space, a One Coworking booking link with date and party size filled in — confirmed when the person pays — or the venue page where they send a request (the space confirms by hand, so prefer instant spaces for a close date). A day pass for several days at one space is one link and one checkout: pass dates (up to 10). A meeting room is one day per link; a workshop or event with a room on several days, several rooms, catering or a seating layout needs a quote, not a link: use request_meeting_space. Not for private offices: use request_office_quotes.

dates.description: A day pass for several days at one space: every day, YYYY-MM-DD (consecutive or not). Instead of date.

end_time.description: HH:MM the space is needed until (skips spaces closed by then).

near.description: A station, landmark, hotel or street address to be close to, e.g. "Hauptbahnhof", "Sendlinger Straße 10". Without venue_slugs: the spaces nearest to it that book directly; with them: walking minutes to each.

name: get_booking_links
title: Get booking links
